text.en: Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically reloads your weapon.
Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically reloads your weapon.

Dodging removes tracking from projectiles fired by PVE combatants and disables the effects of Aim Assist on you for the duration of the animation.

Instantly reloads your held weapon upon dodging.
